title: P-256 sigma rho: A=2^28 (reserve + correction-pad) + kM=3e6 + two ledger repricings (declared 126.870349)

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1, M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure, H3 pricing and H-trail (average correction count per trail) premises. Total charged work is at most 2^126.870349 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. The walk is the accepted crown's (crown A=2^24; HERE A=2^28, K=2^32, theta=2^-60, residual Markov factor raised to 3000000) with tau=0.4943005 and batches of 2^20 walks; only the adder-table size changes, which lowers the two-cycle entry rate 1/(2A), the longer-entry/false-filter residual and the collision-exponent penalty epsilon=10/A+O(1/A^2)=3.725291e-8. The batched step keeps the predecessor's field rows and tests, with both loops unrolled eight times, and its six product finishes per step branch on the carry flag instead of a materialised carry word; every conditional field correction is a forward branch whose taken fix-up adds its exact extra instructions to a run-wide meter capped after every round at n*CORR+LAMBDA_CAP, CORR=22.468426 per step unchanged (dy carries pad 0 by L-ori sign symmetry, all other sites 2^-10). Each global round blinds every batch's prefix chain with one fresh uniform unit rho (charged), so a lane's count depends on its walk point and a uniform prefix only. The cap's abort probability uses only the algorithm's own coins: per-trail Azuma-Hoeffding over independent trail starts with the average premise H-trail, and Hoeffding over independent per-round blinding noise; DELTA_CORR<5.07e-14; the work bound holds regardless. The fixed path is charged at 658,022,038 instructions per 2^20-walk plain round: the previous revision's 659,594,897 less the exact 3*2^19-5 loop-control instructions the eight-copy loops remove (emulated executed-instruction counts of builds made in the organizer's image measure 658,022,010 on a clean round and the 3*2^19-5 difference against the previous kernel; that image's Callgrind on the previous kernel at 2^16 walks equals the emulated count; a 512-instruction main-round method allowance added per round, repriced from 1,024, finishing rounds retaining 1,024), anchor rounds 5*(2^20-1)+9 more, so C_COMMON=627.617941 (repriced from 627.620139) and, with the A=2^28 rare reserve 0.000483 (two-cycle 0.000156, residual kM*E0 0.000328), and with two cost-ledger repricings applied -- blinding-product control 2^11->256 (RHO_COST 384; two 115-instruction branchless rho products per batch round, 230<256; fkiene 84124941) and main-round method allowance 1024->512 (largest observed method gap 28, 512 covers 18x; fkiene 85cfdba6) -- C_COMMON falls from 627.620139 to 627.617941, and (leg 5, new at A=2^28) the correction-meter pad shrinks 2^-10->2^-12 because the adder-table-mean deviation it bounds concentrates as 1/sqrt(A) (DELTA_TABLE=4exp(-2A 2^-24)=4exp(-32)=5.07e-14 unchanged), cutting CORR from 22.468426 to 22.429608, so the step charge is 650.048032 (650.094059 at crown A=2^24, kM=4e5, before repricings); raising kM is cheap because E0 falls to 1.09e-10 at A=2^28, and the freed 1/kM budget lowers tau. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are included. Peak memory is below 2^77 bytes (2^76.491731, record-table dominated; the 2*A*2*64 adder storage is 2^36 bytes, i.e. two 2^35-byte two-sign copies), preprocessing at most 2^62.848077 units, nonuniform advice zero, and the conditional success margin at least 1e-6 above 0.39 (1.1765e-6 at tau=4943005/10000000, kM=3000000). The per-step instruction count is A-invariant: an independent GCC 13.3.0 AArch64 build of measurement/step.c gives batch_step=11,618 instructions at both ADDER_BITS 20 and 28, differing only in immediates, with only rare_anchor (+3) and rare_2cycle (+1) growing inside their per-event OVERHEAD, so the measured fixed-path charge PLAIN_FIXED=658022038 is carried unchanged (evidence/adder-invariance.json). Production probability and universal instruction bounds remain heuristic premises, not certifications. Measurements and finite experiments retain their original scope and attribution.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
